name: Mesh
description: Mesh is a local proxy for LLM API traffic, for teams running their own agents on the Anthropic or OpenAI API: out of the box it makes three lossless changes to each request and records every saving in a hash-chained ledger on your own machine, so you can recompute the bill yourself.
descriptionStatus: The canonical description: the constant MESH_DESCRIPTION in scripts/landing-page.ts on branch gtm/claims-correction at c6acd5c, read 2026-11-25. Not yet on main; keep this field word for word with that constant.
company: Flux AI Technologies Limited, trading as Mesh
audience: Teams running their own agents on the Claude or OpenAI API: coding, browsing, support, retrieval and multi-agent systems. Not aimed at Claude Code users, who gain little.
requirements: Node 22 or newer. macOS and Linux; Windows through WSL.
path: mesh start (Claude Code) or mesh proxy (any app: set the client's base URL to http://127.0.0.1:8787 for Anthropic or http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1 for OpenAI-style clients, and keep your own key)
implementedCapabilities: local proxy for the Anthropic Messages API and the OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses APIs; other calls are forwarded unchanged
on a fresh install, three levers classed lossless: tool-schema compaction, duplicate-context removal, cache-prefix repair
a hash-chained savings ledger on the customer's own disk
mesh verify: re-checks the ledger's hash chain and recomputes the invoice locally, with no network call
mesh statement: a month's statement recomputed from the ledger and signed by that install's key
Theo, a background agent that observes metered traffic and proposes policy changes
offUnlessSwitchedOn: the tool-result cap, which needs a passed quality gate
notImplemented: a hosted service, accounts or automatic billing
plannedCapabilitiesNote: Left empty on purpose. This file describes only what is on main; nothing unreleased is listed or promised.

pricing.fee: The fee is 1% of verified savings for the month, rounded down to the cent, and nothing else; no fee is due unless billing has been agreed in writing.

figures.rule: A figure is quoted only from that file, with its label (LIVE or SIMULATOR), its date, and whether it is out of the box or measured with named levers switched on.
figures.freshInstallPercentage: None exists. Do not state one.

evidenceStatus.customerTraffic: Mesh has never run on a customer's real traffic.
evidenceStatus.realProviderBill: No measurement of Mesh's effect on billed cost per completed task exists.
